evidence.reason: The admission marker is created with O_CREAT|O_EXCL and only the token file is fsynced; the marker's parent directory entry is never fsynced. The code explicitly treats the marker as persisted and recovery-gated, so a power loss can lose the directory entry and drop the admission hold, while an unsynced removal can leave a stale hold after reboot. This is an ordinary durability bug in the intended marker persistence, not a new requirement.
